The '''ceremonial sword''' was an object used in treaties and ceremonies by [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarians]]. King [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]] once presented [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] with his sword. This action represented the king entrusting the safety and defense of his people to Yoda and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].

Later into the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] sent his new assassin, [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], to kidnap Katuunko to exact his revenge on the king for [[The Matter of Using Toydarian Territory to Aid the Shipment of Relief Supplies to the Citizens of Ryloth/Legends|aiding]] the Republic. The king used the ceremonial sword to defend himself, but Opress sliced it in two with his [[Savage Opress's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The king still tried to flee after his weapon was useless, and despite the arrival of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to defend him, Katuunko was killed.

The sword was stored in a [[Scabbard/Legends|scabbard]] on Katuunko's belt.
